data_0022368c+0x14 -> func_001b8ba0(PagedMenuSceneA *); data_002236f4+0x14 -> func_001bc538(PagedMenuSceneB *); data_002237b4+0x14 -> func_001e381c(GridCleanupScreen *); data_00223890+0x14 -> func_001e8024(MotionCleanupScreen *). findings.subject: data_0021df3c CommandCallbacks and NEW 0015121c/00151458/00151584
evidence: include/game/command_group.h:93-107 declares a forward-only CommandTarget and twelve pointer-to-member slots. NEW src/checkpoint10/func_0015121c.cpp:7,17, func_00151458.cpp:7,17 and func_00151584.cpp:7,17 copy and invoke those members.

Private original decoding identifies flagf4(+0x50) -> func_001d4b80 and flagf0(+0x58) -> func_001d4d54. Both real definitions are C-linkage free functions void(SoundParameterTarget *, unsigned char), not members of CommandTarget. flagf4 additionally declares signed char.

fade(+8) -> func_001d4adc(AudioFadeController *, bool, unsigned int), whereas the table declares void(CommandTarget::*)(signed char, int). value108(+0x38) -> func_001d4d48(AudioTransitionState *, float, unsigned char), whereas the table declares (float,int). The float-only entries likewise resolve to free functions on distinct FloatState records.
Independent bounded match of func_00151458 under middleware/v6/L1 reports MATCH 132/132. It does not validate the member-pointer contract.

NEW_deferrals.reason: The new command consumers reinterpret data0021df3c as CommandTarget member pointers while the stored targets are free providers with distinct real receivers and bool/byte/word inputs. No genuine common member owner is recovered.
